annotations.title: Send a change for the holder to approve

description: Send a change to file: new director, new address, shares sold and so on (the law allows 15 days). Nothing is filed from this call: the account holder must approve the change on mapleminute.com (we email them), then our team files it with the registry. Its status shows in get_company.change_requests: waiting_for_approval, approved, filed.
